variant.briefing:
Hello,

Crusader has asked us here at Ling Family Hauling to aid their relief efforts, and it’s extremely important to us as a business and a family to do this right. The thought of what happened to the victims of Orison happening to anyone in my family… We owe it to the survivors to do everything in our power to help them.
The medical supplies Crusader needs are set to get picked up from [Location] and needs to be dropped at [Destination]. And be sure to bring a handheld tractor beam to speed things along.

Thank you, 
Conni Ling
Shipment Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling
